messages:
Maria H.: Quick heads-up — our partner staging demo moved to next Tue. They asked for a soft embargo change: publish moved from Wed 9:00am PST to Wed 11:00am PST. Need to shift the benchmark deep-dive + partner case study. Can comms team confirm timeline?
Aj P.: Noted. Which assets exactly are we shifting — benchmark deep-dive and the partner case study, right?
Maria H.: Correct. Both. Benchmark was queued for Wed morning; partner wants Wed 11:00am PST embargo instead of 09:00. Two-hour delay.
Leo K.: Any press calls that would collide? I have a tentative slot with TechDaily at 10am.
Kate R.: I had outreach scheduled at 9:30 for top-tier list. Can we move outreach to 11:15? That gives press time after embargo lift. Will need updated press list email copy.
Samir V.: We'll have to shift social syndication too. I can update Buffer. @PressBot — please hold the scheduled posts until we confirm.
PressBot: Automated: Holding scheduled posts for thread 2136543210. Schedule IDs paused: 78910, 78911. Reply 'resume' to release.
Aj P.: Also flagging sales + CS — we should update the waitlist/customers template that had 'publishing at 9am'.
Kate R.: Draft of updated press note below, please quick review:
``
Subject: Press embargo — Redwood x Partner demo
Hi <name>,
Heads-up — embargo moved to Wed 11:00am PST. Please hold any coverage until then. We'll follow up with the embargo lift notice and assets at 11:00.
Thanks,
Kate on behalf of Redwood comms
```
Leo K.: LGTM. Suggest dropping the phrase "game-changer" from the boilerplate — sounds hyperbolic.
Maria H.: Good call. Kate, can you remove hype language and add the partner's legal copy line? Partner insisted on one-sentence attribution.
Kate R.: Will do. Also: proposed tweet copy for syndication (safe copy for partner):
``
Were excited to demo our new inference throughput improvements with @PartnerCo — watch the demo and benchmarks on Wed at 11:00am PST. Read more: https://redwood.inference/demo
```
Leo K.: Suggest swapping "excited" -> "showcasing" and remove the URL duplicate.
Samir V.: I'll update Buffer schedule to 11:18am PST for staggered posting (press at 11:00, social 11:18). Once set I'll ping ops to adjust webhooks.
PressBot: Automated: Reschedule request acknowledged. New tentative publish epoch: 2136572280 (Wed 11:18am PST).
Samir V.: Done — Buffer updated, social posts rescheduled to 11:18 PST. Ops webhook queued. :white_check_mark:
Maria H.: Thanks all. I'll send the embargo confirmation to partner once Kate shares the cleaned press note and the legal attribution line. I'll also update the internal launch doc and tag Sales + CS. Closing loop here unless anyone has blockers.
Kate R.: Sending updated press note in 5.
Aj P.: I'll ping TechDaily and offer an alternate slot. Thanks team.
Maria H.: ✅
